modifications: Normalized to JSON, joined by headword, added separately identified original learning material and offline B2 First word-family/inflection notes.

offlineLearningMaterial.note: Original practice material aligned with B2 First word formation and collocation skills; not official exam questions. Relations are sense-dependent, not interchangeable in every context.

completeOfflineCards.method: Original model-authored B1-B2 contextual examples and bilingual collocations, generated once and validated before bundling. No Tatoeba or dictionary example sentences are used.
completeOfflineCards.scope: One 14-32 word English sentence, Chinese translation, and two distinct bilingual collocations per official NGSL ID. Optional corrected Chinese gloss is kept separate from the original source gloss.

lexicalCorrections.note: Corrected display POS/English definition where the original gloss and label disagree. The original fields and word IDs are preserved.

commonMeanings.note: Original learner-focused common meanings, grouped by part of speech, and independently explained fixed phrases. Each meaning has a bilingual B1-B2 example and usage pattern. This is not an exhaustive historical dictionary.
